verdict.rationale: Omnara is open source under Apache 2.0 and explicitly free to self-host. Its GitHub repo references self-hosted deployments backed by Postgres, and agents can run on a machine you connect, such as a laptop or server, without opening inbound ports. However, the pack has no deployment guide, no container or Docker packaging, and no VM-specific instructions, so how deep the self-hosting support goes is unproven. Missing for 10: documented container/Docker deployment, VM or infra deployment guides, hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted install.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can self-host agent infrastructure locally, in containers, or on my own VMs

citations.quote: Free to self-host and build on. Open source under Apache 2.0.
Self-hosted deployments can query agent history directly in Postgres
or a machine you connect, such as a laptop or server
You do not need to open inbound ports, distribute SSH keys, or give Omnara a network path into your infrastructure.
